correctness.rationale: For every n-vertex tree, Σd(v)=2(n-1), so the degree gap numerator is nΔ-2(n-1). Unique tree geodesics give b(v)=Σ_{i<j}s_i s_j for components of T-v. For A=S(4,1,1,1), Δ=4 and degree gap 18, betweenness max15 and gap77, yielding C_D=3/7 and C_B=11/21. For B=S(3,2,2), Δ=3 and gap10, betweenness max16 and gap84, yielding C_D=5/21 and C_B=4/7; signs reverse. Independently, networkx nonisomorphic_trees enumerated every unlabelled tree at n=3..8 (counts 1,2,3,6,11,23), recomputed betweenness centrally using its own algorithm, and compared pairs exactly; reversal counts 0,0,0,0,0,8. This finite exhaustive cut-off establishes minimality at n≤8, not all-order comparisons.
